result.brief: 提出 OpenWAM 开放框架，基于因果机器人视频基础模型与可配置视频-动作交互，统一比较世界-动作模型设计并研究反事实动力学学习。
result.reason: Builds a causal robot-video foundation world-action model with configurable video-action interaction, dynamics learning, and counterfactual supervision; robot policy is the application, but the video backbone and world modeling are core contributions.
